kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

lines.say: Read this one over your house tonight.
lines.big: Read this one over your house tonight

lines.say: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. Psalm ninety one, verse one.
lines.big: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

lines.say: The secret place isn't a building. It's staying close to him.
lines.big: The secret place isn't a building. It's staying close to him.

lines.say: Lord, let me abide under your shadow tonight. Cover my house. In Jesus' name, amen.
